title: If you’re a PM…
visibleText:
If you’re a PM…
Users ask for features.
Teams ask for priorities.
Stakeholders ask for answers.
Before adding a feature,
make sure everyone is solving the same problem.
And yes, your designer can make it pretty while helping you solve these problems.

title: If you're an Engineer...
visibleText:
If you're an Engineer...
Requirements change.
Language changes.
Business changes
Sometimes the code is fine. The understanding isn’t.
And yes, your designer can make it pretty.
Sometimes without touching your code.

title: If you’re my fellow designers...
visibleText:
If you’re my fellow designers...
Follow the workflow.
Follow the language.
Follow the rules.
That’s where the real business logic lives.
Yes, sometimes the ugly screen is telling you something.
Understand first. Then make it pretty.
